note: The case table of the Command line matcher (assets/js/lib/command-match.js). The content check (assets/js/lib/validate-core.js) types every row through the matcher, in the browser and on GitHub, and a row that does not get what it says blocks publishing. Test fixtures only: no site content. Addresses and names are documentation ranges. Odd characters are written as \u escapes so a reviewer can see them. matcher must equal MATCHER_VERSION. sets: a system, the stored lines by answer group, the targets the task gave, and alsoWorks. cases: s the set, t the typed line, x the code it must get, and, when the row names them, g the group, line, exact, on (the systems of another system's command), label and tag (the words on screen), and keep (whether the line stays in the field). given: rows for givenTargets. commandLines: rows for isCommandLine. ev = how the row is known: run (run on a Windows 11 PC, 2026-11-19 or 2026-11-20), doc (documentation or source code, docs/COMMAND-LINE-PLAN.md Appendix H), rule (a decision or a design rule), gk (general knowledge, nobody has run it), notrun (would change the PC, so it was never run).
